description_en: Queries the details of a resource diagnostic report by calling DescribeDiagnosticReportAttributes
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-diagnostic-report-attributes --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --report-id dr-i-uf6i0tv2refv8wz00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDiagnosticReportAttributes

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the diagnostic report
parameters.name: report_id

Attributes.description_en: The extended attributes of the diagnostic report

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the diagnostic report was created. The time is in ISO 8601 format in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 诊断报告创建时间。格式为 ISO 8601，时区为 UTC

EndTime.description_en: The end time. This is the parameter passed in when you called the [CreateDiagnosticReport]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/442490.html） operation to create the diagnostic report. The time is in ISO 8601 format in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 结束时间。调用[CreateDiagnosticReport]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/442490.html）接口创建诊断报告时传入的参数。格式为 ISO 8601，时区为 UTC

FinishedTime.description_en: The time when the diagnostic report was completed. The time is in ISO 8601 format in UTC
FinishedTime.description_zh: 诊断报告完成时间。格式为 ISO 8601，时区为 UTC

MetricResult.description_en: The diagnostic results of all metrics in the diagnostic set
MetricResult.description_zh: 诊断集合中所有指标的诊断结果

Additional.description_en: The additional data associated with the diagnostic issue. This data helps you understand more information about the issue. The data is in JSON string format
Additional.description_zh: 诊断问题携带的额外数据，帮助理解问题更多信息，数据格式为JSON的字符串

IssueId.description_en: The unique identifier of the diagnostic issue
IssueId.description_zh: 诊断问题的唯一识别码

OccurrenceTime.description_en: The time when the issue occurred. The time is in ISO 8601 format in UTC
OccurrenceTime.description_zh: 问题发生的时间。格式为 ISO 8601，时区为 UTC

RepairStatus.description_en:
The repair status. This field has a value after a repair operation is performed. Valid values:
InProgress: The repair is in progress.
Failed: The repair failed.
Finished: The repair is complete
RepairStatus.description_zh:
修复状态，执行修复操作后有值。取值范围：
InProgress：修复中。
Failed：修复失败。
Finished：修复完成
RepairStatus.title_zh:
修复状态，执行修复操作后有值。取值范围：
InProgress：修复中。
Failed：修复失败。
Finished：修复完成。

Repairable.description_en: Indicates whether the issue can be automatically repaired. Valid values: false (not repairable) and true (repairable)
Repairable.description_zh: 是否可自动化修复：false-不可修复，true-可修复
Repairable.title_zh: 是否可自动化修复：false-不可修复，true-可修复

Severity.description_en:
The severity level of the diagnostic issue. The severity levels in ascending order are:

Info: Related information is available and may be associated with an exception.
Warn: Related information is available and may cause an exception.
Critical: A critical exception exists
Severity.description_zh:
诊断问题严重程度，严重等级由轻到重如下：

Info：有关联信息，可能与异常相关。
Warn：有关联信息，可能导致异常。
Critical：有关键异常

MetricCategory.description_en: The category of the diagnostic metric

MetricId.description_en: The ID of the diagnostic metric

Severity.description_en:
The severity level of the diagnostic metric. Valid values:

Unknown: The initial state. The diagnosis has not started, or the diagnostic process exited abnormally. No diagnostic conclusion is available.
Normal: The diagnosis is normal. No issues were found.
Info: Related information is available and may be associated with an exception.
NotSupport: The guest OS version does not support diagnosing this item.
Warn: Related information is available and may cause an exception.
Critical: A critical exception exists
Severity.description_zh:
诊断指标严重等级。可能值：

Unknown：初始状态，表示未开始诊断或者诊断过程程序异常退出，无诊断结论。
Normal：诊断正常，没有发现问题。
Info：有关联信息，可能与异常相关。
NotSupport：GuestOS版本不支持诊断该项目。
Warn：有关联信息，可能导致异常。
Critical：有关键异常

Status.description_en:
The diagnostic status of the metric. Valid values:

InProgress: The diagnosis is in progress.
Finished: The diagnosis is complete.
Failed: The diagnosis failed
Status.description_zh:
指标诊断状态。可能值：

InProgress：诊断中。
Finished：诊断完成。
Failed：诊断失败

MetricSetId.description_en: The ID of the diagnostic metric set

ReportId.description_en: The ID of the diagnostic report. This is the unique identifier of the resource diagnostic report
ReportId.description_zh: 诊断报告ID。资源诊断报告的唯一标志

ResourceType.description_en: The resource type. The supported type is instance
ResourceType.description_zh: 资源类型。支持的类型为instance

Severity.description_en:
The severity level of the report. This is the most severe level among all metrics. The severity levels in ascending order are:

Unknown: The initial state. The diagnosis has not started, or the diagnostic process exited abnormally. No diagnostic conclusion is available.
Normal: The diagnosis is normal. No issues were found.
Info: Related information is available and may be associated with an exception.
Warn: Related information is available and may cause an exception.
Critical: A critical exception exists
Severity.description_zh:
报告严重等级。所有指标中最严重的等级，严重等级由轻到重如下：

Unknown：初始状态，表示未开始诊断或者诊断过程程序异常退出，无诊断结论。
Normal：诊断正常，没有发现问题。
Info：有关联信息，可能与异常相关。
Warn：有关联信息，可能导致异常。
Critical：有关键异常

StartTime.description_en: The start time. This is the parameter passed in when you called the [CreateDiagnosticReport]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/442490.html） operation to create the diagnostic report. The time is in ISO 8601 format in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 开始时间。调用[CreateDiagnosticReport]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/442490.html）接口创建诊断报告时传入的参数。格式为 ISO 8601，时区为 UTC

Status.description_en:
The status of the diagnostic report. Valid values:

InProgress: The diagnosis is in progress.
Finished: The diagnosis is complete.
Failed: The diagnosis failed
Status.description_zh:
诊断报告状态。可能值：

InProgress：诊断中。
Finished：诊断完成。
Failed：诊断失败
